verdict.rationale: BVNK is a payments SaaS that handles customer data, so whether it lets users opt out of AI-training use of their data is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, data-usage policy, or related control. The webhook validator's client-side handling of sensitive data is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
